original_idea.body:
# LW Kill Chain Stage Attribution: Which Stages Are Currently Detectable by Developer-Side Monitoring?

**Problem:** The LW threat matrix says early kill-chain stages are developer-addressable but the boundary between developer-detectable and cloud-provider-only-detectable stages is fuzzy.

**Direction:** For each tactic in the LW threat matrix, attempt to generate a monitoring signal from developer-side telemetry (LLM API logs, tool call logs, output classifiers). Determine empirically which tactics produce detectable signals at this level vs. require infrastructure-level visibility.

**Why it matters:** Clarifying this boundary is essential for determining what developers can do independently vs. what requires cloud provider partnerships.

**Relevant context:** LW 2026 Loss of Control Threat Matrix; cloud provider visibility gap.
